user_query: Analyze this protein sequence comprehensively. Determine its likely molecular function, family/domain classification, cellular localization, oligomeric or nucleic-acid-binding characteristics, and important sequence features. Distinguish curated evidence from homology-based inference and report uncertainty.

warnings: Sequence-derived estimates assume an unmodified protein and do not account for processing, PTMs, bound ligands, or oligomers.

annotation.organism: Mycoplasma mycoides subsp. mycoides SC (strain CCUG 32753 / NCTC 10114 / PG1)
function: RNaseP catalyzes the removal of the 5'-leader sequence from pre-tRNA to produce the mature 5'-terminus. It can also cleave other RNA substrates such as 4.5S RNA. The protein component plays an auxiliary but essential role in vivo by binding to the 5'-leader sequence and broadening the substrate specificity of the ribozyme.
